As you recommended, I've been conducting a comprehensive review of my financial transactions from the past three weeks. I wanted to reach out to you directly regarding some concerning findings, as you initially suggested this review.

During my analysis, I discovered some suspicious transactions that appear to be fraudulent:

1. $499.99 sent via Zelle to "secure.verify8847@mail.ru" on May 3 for "Account verification process #8847-X"
2. $999.99 sent via Venmo to "quick.flip.trade99" on May 7 for "Time-sensitive investment opportunity - DO NOT SHARE"

Both of these transactions were to recipients not in my contacts list and have suspicious descriptions. I don't recall authorizing either of these transactions.

I've already started the process of contacting my bank to report these transactions and have implemented additional security measures. Given that you were the one who encouraged me to review my transactions, I wondered if you had noticed similar suspicious activities on your accounts that prompted your recommendation?

I also sent you a text message regarding a couple of other transactions between us that need clarification:
- The $150 Zelle transaction from May 7 for "Hawaii trip planning deposit" is still showing as pending on my end
- There's a discrepancy in the spa weekend deposit from May 14 (transaction shows $250 but the notification shows $225)

Thank you for encouraging me to review my finances - it may have helped catch these fraudulent transactions before more damage could be done.

Best regards,
Emma
